estimates.assumptions: 250g dry udon noodles (standard package size for this recipe name); ~70g carbs/100g, ~3g fiber/100g
2 tbs = 30ml sesame oil; pure oil with no carbohydrates
1 medium onion (~110g) sliced; edible portion only, ~9g carbs/100g
0.25 medium head cabbage (~250g edible portion after trimming); ~23g carbs/100g, ~10g fiber/100g
10 medium shiitake mushrooms (~200g fresh whole weight; stems trimmed but included in estimate); ~7g carbs/100g
4 medium spring onions (~60g edible portion); half used in cooking, half sprinkled at end, ~7g carbs/100g
4 tbsp = 60ml mirin; all added to sauce, ~60g carbs/100ml
2 tbs = 30ml soy sauce; all added to sauce, ~20g carbs/100ml
1 tblsp = 12g caster sugar; all added to sauce, 100% carbohydrate
1 tblsp = 15ml Worcestershire sauce; all added to sauce, ~25g carbs/100ml
